title: invocation-condensor-and-alert-latency-whisperer
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: token-level telemetry volume and high-cardinality span churn have been driving query cost and noisy alerting during tail latency events. This PR introduces two complementary components: 1) an invocation condensor (gist-index) that compactly represents dense, repeated span shapes as "gists" and emits lightweight rollups, and 2) an Alert Latency Whisperer algorithm that smooths short-lived tail spikes with an adaptive decay window so oncall noise is reduced without hiding real regressions.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds a gist-index service (in-process library + background aggregator) that: deduplicates similar invocation traces into gist IDs, emits per-gist rollup metrics (invocation_count, median_token_latency_ms, token_cost_usd_est), and stores sketch samples for on-demand rehydration.
- Exposes token-level microbreakdown labels on rollups: token_latency_ms, token_cost_usd, kv_cache_hit_ratio, model_variant, and energy_joules_est. These are intended for aggregate rollups (not raw per-token logs).
- Implements the Alert Latency Whisperer: a policy that applies exponential decay to short-lived percentile regressions and reweights alerts by recent persistence and per-route importance.
- Adds Grafana dashboard panels for gist rollups and a compact token-cost waterfall per-route; adds Prometheus alert rules for the whisperer and a small playbook.

Design notes:
- Gist keys are computed using a normalized invocation fingerprint (callsite + prompt-shape bucketing + kernel-queue-peak-sig) so we keep cardinality bounded. The gist-index stores: last_seen_ts, total_tokens, aggregated_latency_p50/p90/p99 sketches (DDSketch), and a sampled trace anchor.
- Rollup metrics use the existing metric pipeline (prometheus exporter + metric router). We add a new metric namespace telemetry.gist.* and suffix labels for the microbreakdown fields. The SDKs surface a small API to fetch gist rollups for a given route.
- Whisperer picks a smoothing half-life per-route using historical volatility (default half-life = 2 minutes for high-volume routes, up to 15 minutes for low-volume). Alerts are suppressed for anomalies that decay faster than the configured half-life; persistent regressions still fire immediately but with escalated severity.

Files changed (high level):
- src/telemetry/gist_indexer.go: core gist computation, in-memory index + disk-backed checkpoints.
- pkg/telemetry/whisperer.go: alert smoothing state machine and evaluation hooks.
- exporters/prometheus/gist_metrics.go: new metric export paths (telemetry_gist_*).
- dashboards/gist_rollup_panels.json: Grafana panels (compact rollup + token-cost waterfall).
- infra/alerts/prometheus/gist_whisperer_rules.yaml: new alert rules and recording rules for persistence scoring.
- sdk/python/redwood/telemetry.py: client helpers to query gist rollups and fetch sampled trace anchors.
- docs/observability/gist-index.md: design doc, rollout steps, and runbook.
- tests/gist_indexer_test.go and tests/whisperer_integration_test.go: unit and integration coverage including synthetic replay with token-shaped load.

Commits summary:
- feat(gist): add in-memory gist index, fingerprinting and checkpointing (Maya Chen)
- feat(telemetry): export gist rollup metrics and microbreakdown labels (Maya Chen)
- feat(whisperer): implement alert-latency-whisperer policy and eval hooks (Maya Chen)
- test: add unit and e2e replay tests, add synthetic token workloads (Maya Chen)
- docs: observability guide for gist index and whisperer (Maya Chen)

Testing and CI:
- Local unit tests: gist indexing edge cases (fingerprints collision, checkpoint recovery).
- Integration: replaybench used to synthetically pump 10k invocations/min with three prompt-shapes; validated that gist cardinality is bounded and that rollup accuracy is within 2% of ground truth.
- Alert simulation: historic week replay to validate the Whisperer suppressed 62% of transient p99 spikes while still firing for sustained regressions.
- CI history: initial push showed a flakey test (whisperer timing test) failing (flake on low-spec CI); test timeout adjusted and rerun — green.

Rollout plan: staged canary: 10% traffic (48h) -> 33% (72h) -> 100% (5 days) with automatic rollback if persistent p99 latency increases >5% for 1 hour. A telemetry-only shadow mode is supported in feature flag so customers can preview gist rollups in the console without enabling suppression.

Backward compatibility and migration:
- Metrics use new metric namespace; dashboards reference the new recording rules. Old raw span flow is unchanged and available for on-demand rehydration.
- No breaking RPC or SDK surface changes other than optional client helpers in SDKs to fetch gist rollups.

Security & privacy: sampled traces are anchor-only (no full prompt persisted in gist store by default). We added a config toggle to redact prompt text when customers require stricter controls. Docs include guidance for compliance and retention.

Follow-ups (future work):
- Cross-tenant gist dedup heuristics for multi-tenant sharing (requires policy review).
- Auto-tune half-life using RL-style optimizer from historical SLO outcomes.

This description is intentionally compact; see docs/observability/gist-index.md for diagrams and math.

review_thread:
Priya Rao: Can gist IDs collide across tenants? If so we need tenant-scoped prefixes.
Maya Chen: Great catch — gist keys are tenant-scoped by default; added tests and docs note.
Luca Moretti: Whisperer looks promising; how do we guarantee we don't mask slowly developing regressions?
Maya Chen: Whisperer uses a persistence score (time-weighted anomaly integral) so regressions that accumulate across evaluation windows escalate immediately; added integration test to cover this.
Samir Patel: Dashboard looks dense for SRE oncall — can we add a compact 'why this fired' link?
Maya Chen: Added a compact summary panel and a deeplink to sampled trace anchor; updated dashboard JSON.
Priya Rao: CI flake on whisperer timing test — timeout tuned.
Samir Patel: Approve after small doc tweak.
Luca Moretti: Approved.
Merge-bot: Squash and merge after CI green.
release_notes: New: gist-index rollups (telemetry.gist.*), Alert Latency Whisperer for smoothing transient p99 spikes, Grafana panels for gist rollups and per-route token-cost waterfall. Config: telemetry.gist.enabled=false by default.
notes: Feature gated behind telemetry.gist.enabled; SDK helpers optional. Oncall playbook added to docs/observability/gist-index.md
